designer.description: I’m Alicia, a designer based in Manila, specializing in email design for DTC brands. My approach blends function with creativity, so every design feels intentional, engaging, and true to the brand. Building a brand is like finding the right puzzle pieces—it takes strategy, storytelling, and the right people who really get what you’re trying to do.
